headline: 7.7-magnitude quake off Indonesia kills at least 20 people
summary: A powerful earthquake struck off Flores island, sparking mass evacuations and a temporary tsunami warning as rescuers search for survivors in the debris.
details: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck off the north coast of Flores island in eastern Indonesia on Saturday, leaving at least 20 people dead and six others injured.
Rescue official Fathur Rahman confirmed the deaths across four different towns on the island, noting that several people remain buried under rubble in Nagekeo and Manggarai regencies.
The quake's epicenter was located approximately 68 kilometers northwest of the coastal town of Ende, with the shallow nature of the quake causing significant structural damage.
Residents in Nagekeo raced for higher ground after observing the sea retreat, a common sign of an approaching tsunami. A tsunami warning was later lifted by the BMKG agency.
Dozens of aftershocks have been recorded, the strongest of which measured 6.1 magnitude, leading authorities to warn residents not to return to damaged buildings.
The affected area is primarily composed of towns and villages, with few high-rise buildings, but hospitals and other structures have reported cracked walls and panic among residents.
Indonesia's location in the Pacific 'Ring of Fire' makes it highly susceptible to frequent and intense seismic activity, with a history of devastating quakes in the same region.
Similar disasters in the region, including a 1992 quake on Flores and a 2004 tsunami in Sumatra, highlight the ongoing risk of seismic activity in the region.

headline_marked: Bangladesh takes [[228-run first-innings lead]] against Australia in Darwin
headline: Bangladesh takes 228-run first-innings lead against Australia in Darwin
summary: Hasan Mahmud strikes early in the second innings as Australia struggle to recover from a massive deficit in the first Test.
details: Bangladesh has secured a commanding 228-run lead in the first innings of the first Test against Australia in Darwin, bowling the hosts out for 198 before scoring 426.
Hasan Mahmud continued his dominance on the third day, removing both Australian openers, Jake Weatherald and Travis Head, early in their second innings.
Australia currently trails by 177 runs at tea, with Marnus Labuschagne and Steve Smith fighting to stabilize the innings after several close calls.
Mehidy Hasan Miraz played a crucial role with the bat, scoring 65 runs to help stretch the lead beyond 200 before being dismissed by Josh Hazlewood.
Hazlewood achieved a major milestone, claiming his 300th Test wicket and his 14th five-wicket haul, finishing with figures of 6 for 89.
Historically, Australia has won only three Tests after conceding a first-innings lead of more than 200 runs, the last occurring in 2010 against Pakistan.
caption:
A massive 228-run lead! Bangladesh puts Australia in a historic hole during the first Test in Darwin.

Bangladesh has secured a commanding 228-run lead in the first innings of the first Test against Australia in Darwin, bowling the hosts out for 198 before scoring 426.

Australia currently trails by 177 runs at tea, with Marnus Labuschagne and Steve Smith fighting to stabilize the innings after several close calls.

Mehidy Hasan Miraz played a crucial role with the bat, scoring 65 runs to help stretch the lead beyond 200 before being dismissed by Josh Hazlewood.

Hazlewood achieved a major milestone, claiming his 300th Test wicket and his 14th five-wicket haul, finishing with figures of 6 for 89.

Historically, Australia has won only three Tests after conceding a first-innings lead of more than 200 runs, the last occurring in 2010 against Pakistan.
